blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday called on Filipinos to pray for the swift and full recovery of Pope Leo XIV, who was diagnosed with lung cancer. The 71-year-old pontiff underwent surgery to remove the lower lobe of his right lung. The Vatican said he had resumed his regular diet, begun walking and celebrated Mass in the hospital while recovering from surgery.
